subtitle: A 1.2-kilometer sand beach on the tombolo that connects Howth Head, once an island, to the Dublin mainland at Sutton, County Dublin.
spike_statement: Burrow Beach runs along a sand-and-gravel tombolo that turned Howth Head from an island into a peninsula joined to Dublin's mainland at Sutton.

levers.photo_tone: Flat grey-green Irish Sea light over pale sand and marram-grass dunes, Howth's dark headland closing the horizon.
